title: Canonicalization and crawl bounds
question: Which frontier rules terminate a crawl through traps and changing tables without losing or duplicating any record (architecture §3.1)?

options.description: Parameters declared by the recipe removed (sid, utm_*), no-effect parameters learned by page signature, trapped paths closed after three empty pages, cursor pagination (rel=next) preferred over page numbers
Deduplication key = exact URL, all links followed, request budget

notes: The canonical option is the reference: the naive option is judged against it, and its gate fails as soon as a table modified during the crawl makes it lose rows while declaring itself complete. Requests are counted by the site, independently of the host.
